description: Implied volatility (IV) of crypto options per expiry from Deribit, Bybit and OKX: ATM IV, 25-delta skew, put/call open interest ratio, max pain and Deribit's DVOL index; with an expiry, the options chain per strike with the greeks as each venue publishes them. Volatility surface inputs for BTC and ETH options. Data only. Bad input is free; nothing is charged when no venue answers. Price: $0.003 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base); pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

coin.description: Coin symbol: BTC, ETH, SOL, PEPE ... (also BTCUSDT, BTC-PERP, XBT, 1000PEPE, kPEPE).

expiry.description: Optional expiry date YYYY-MM-DD (UTC): that expiry plus its chain with the venues' greeks.
